title: Piezo1 as a Key Mechanosensitive Ion Channel Linking Mechanical Overload to Mitochondrial Dysfunction, Mitophagy, and Immunometabolic Dysregulation in Osteoarthritis.
snippet: Osteoarthritis (OA) is increasingly recognized as a mechanically driven whole-joint disease in which abnormal mechanotransduction initiates a cascade of mitochondrial dysfunction, chronic inflammation, and progressive cartilage degeneration.
